description: This file contains function prototypes, macro guards, licensing and copyright information, and module documentation for the Slap Sco Standard Object API in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It defines external functions related to object creation, removal, object enrollment, initialization, and reset operations.

methods.name: SlapCreateScoStandard
methods.description: Creates a new SLAP Sco Standard object with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: SlapScoStdCreate
methods.description: Creates a new SLAP Sco Standard object.

methods.name: SlapScoStdRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified SLAP Sco Standard object.

methods.name: SlapScoStdEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the SLAP Sco Standard object.

methods.name: SlapScoStdInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Sco Standard object.

methods.name: SlapScoStdReset
methods.description: Resets the SLAP Sco Standard object to its default state.
